findings.summary: `## Applied Waivers` repeated one authorization once per implementation round with no column to tell the rows apart.
findings.evidence: Repair commit 8270065 `src/logger.ts:476-505`: `writeSummary` now builds a `firstApplications` Map keyed `${event.ghIssue} ${event.riskClass} ${event.path}` that keeps the first `waiver-applied` event, and the table header gained a `Round` column (`| Slice | Round | Risk class | Path | Author | Reason |`). `src/logger.test.ts:302-354` adds `it("[behavior:B-14] QA-01: renders one row per authorization, not one per round")`, which emits two `waiver-applied` events for `deleted-test` + `src/legacy-parser.test.ts` in rounds 1 and 2 plus one for a second path in round 2, then asserts `rows` has length 2 and `toBe`-matches `| 193 | 1 | deleted-test | src/legacy-parser.test.ts | eric | ... |` and `| 193 | 2 | deleted-test | src/other-parser.test.ts | eric | ... |`. `pnpm vitest run src/logger.test.ts` -> `Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 33 passed (33)`. `round` is a required `number` on the event variant (`src/run-events.ts:191`) and the orchestrator emits it from the round variable (`src/orchestrator.ts:6058`), so no row can render `undefined`. The P-06 omission case (`src/logger.test.ts:356-380`) still asserts `not.toContain("## Applied Waivers")`.
findings.expected: The summary either de-duplicates on slice + risk class + path or carries the round the event already holds, with a logger test covering two `waiver-applied` events for one waiver in different rounds.
findings.observed: Both remedies shipped together: the section de-duplicates on ghIssue + risk class + path, keeps the first application, and renders that application's round in a new column; the required two-events-one-waiver logger test exists and passes.
findings.clearCondition: The summary either de-duplicates on slice + risk class + path or carries the round the event already holds, with a logger test covering two `waiver-applied` events for one waiver in different rounds.
